environment.compute: CPU; one numerical/OpenCV/Torch thread per process, nice10; no production environment installation

script_version.strategy: SHA256 of exact saved implementation, not a fabricated Git release

hashing.pixel: SHA256(big endian uint32 width + uint32 height + decoded RGB row-major bytes); no EXIF orientation transposition
hashing.phash: OpenCV RGB2GRAY, INTER_AREA resize32x32, float32 cv2.dct, upperleft8x8 coefficients > median of63 coefficients excludingDC; all64 bits includingDC; row-major top-left is most significant bit; 16 lowercase hex
hashing.dhash: OpenCV RGB2GRAY, INTER_AREA resize9x8; compare right pixel > left pixel; row-major64 booleans, first is most significant bit;16 lowercase hex

inventory.tiny_bbox: min native side<2px or native area<4px2
inventory.blank: gray std<2 OR entropy<0.5bit OR black(gray<=5)>0.99 OR white(gray>=250)>0.99
inventory.Small_risk: only Occluded=0; Small1 and anybox_longside672>50, or Small0 and allbox_longside672<30; not error verdict
inventory.Occluded_risk: No automatic judgment; Occluded0 with box near boundary<0.002 is visual candidate only
inventory.Blurred: No automatic judgment from global sharpness; human interpretation of directional ball/camera motion required

thresholds.hash_index: BK tree exact64-bit Hamming radius16; candidate pHash<=12 OR dHash<=10
thresholds.candidate_retrieval: Cross split eval-query top5 plus reverse top1, normalized exact blocked dot product; no within-train all-pairs
thresholds.ssim: Gaussian11 sigma1.5, data_range255, valid5px border; base128x72;61 initially high refined256x144,58 remained automated high after refinement
thresholds.alignment: Translation diagnostic on58 automated high after refinement; response>=0.3, norm shift<=8px, extra10px border crop;26 valid aligned pairs

risk_policy.critical: file/pixel exact or confirmed same video/frame
risk_policy.high_temporal: confirmed same video and <=1 second, irrespective of visual score
risk_policy.high_visual: (pHash<=4 AND dHash<=6 AND (cosine>=.97 OR SSIM>=.82)) OR (cosine>=.985 AND SSIM>=.60 AND (pHash<=8 OR dHash<=8))
risk_policy.justification: Operational review triage, not universal duplicate thresholds; joint signals only; low SSIM cannot veto camera motion/exposure candidates. No automatic deletion or split assignment.

embedding_model.pooling: mean of final backbone feature map H,W, before classifier

preprocess.crop: none; whole-frame anisotropic resize to preserve all edge content

embedding_model.limitation: ImageNet classification backbone, not DINOv2. Whole-frame warp differs from official center-crop evaluation. Similarity is candidate evidence, not proof of event identity or leakage.
embedding_model.retrieval: exact cross-split normalized inner product in bounded NumPy batches; no within-train all-pairs
